texts.preamble: Ashoksinh Vikramsinh Rajput vs Anil R Mukikm on 20 July, 2016 Author: S.R.Brahmbhatt Bench: S.R.Brahmbhatt, A.Y. Kogje C/Mca/1923/2016 Order
texts.arguments: The learned advocate appearing for the applicant has invited this Court's attention to the directions contained in order dated 04.12.2015 passed in Special Civil Application No. 9925 of 2015 and led emphasis upon the following wordings: ".... we find that the Food Analyst of concerning area shall take the samples of the product of respondent No.6, shall examine the correct branding and purity of the product, by following the procedure as per the requirement of Section 47 of the Act...." The learned counsel appearing for the applicant invited this Court's attention to the reply, which the applicant received at page-23 and HC-NIC Page 1 of 2 Created On Tue Jul 26 05:39:17 IST 2016 submitted that from the simple and plain reading thereof, it can well be said that part of the order is complied with and part of the order is remained to be complied, as correct branding as per the Act being The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, was in fact as a matter of grievance, the misbranding was alleged and therefore, apropos that grievance, the Court issued orders for correct branding as well as purity of the product, by following the procedure as per the requirements of Section 47 of the Act.
texts.petitioner_arguments: The learned advocate appearing for the applicant has invited this Court's attention to the directions contained in order dated 04.12.2015 passed in Special Civil Application No. 9925 of 2015 and led emphasis upon the following wordings: ".... we find that the Food Analyst of concerning area shall take the samples of the product of respondent No.6, shall examine the correct branding and purity of the product, by following the procedure as per the requirement of Section 47 of the Act...." The learned counsel appearing for the applicant invited this Court's attention to the reply, which the applicant received at page-23 and HC-NIC Page 1 of 2 Created On Tue Jul 26 05:39:17 IST 2016 submitted that from the simple and plain reading thereof, it can well be said that part of the order is complied with and part of the order is remained to be complied, as correct branding as per the Act being The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, was in fact as a matter of grievance, the misbranding was alleged and therefore, apropos that grievance, the Court issued orders for correct branding as well as purity of the product, by following the procedure as per the requirements of Section 47 of the Act.
